description: Compact feed of currently active NasDecode Market Watch catalysts.

activeEvents.companyMarket: SMIC / AI foundry supply / memory / semiconductor equipment / SOX
activeEvents.headline: SMIC expects AI semiconductor supply-chain tightness through 2027 and memory balance only in late 2028
activeEvents.direction: Positive demand indication; mixed cost and supply implications
activeEvents.scope: Semiconductor manufacturing / AI capacity / memory / equipment
activeEvents.whyItMatters: SMIC Co-CEO Zhao Haijun said AI data-center and private-cloud demand will keep AI-related chip supply tight through 2027; memory supply and demand may balance only in mid-to-late 2028. Equipment lead times can exceed 24 months, potentially constraining capacity expansion. This is a new foundry-side supply outlook, not verified incremental orders or a forecast specific to Nvidia.

activeEvents.companyMarket: Cerebras / Microsoft / AI inference / NVDA / SOX
activeEvents.headline: Cerebras lifts 2026 revenue forecast and announces Microsoft cloud deal as AI compute demand grows
activeEvents.direction: Positive for Cerebras; mixed for incumbent GPU vendors
activeEvents.scope: AI accelerators / inference / cloud infrastructure / Microsoft
activeEvents.whyItMatters: Cerebras raised 2026 adjusted revenue guidance to $940M-$960M from $880M-$890M, reported Q3 adjusted sales growth of 70% to $230.9M, and disclosed a new cloud deal with Microsoft. Cloud and services revenue more than tripled to $144.9M; remaining performance obligations were $26.1B, predominantly linked to OpenAI. This is direct evidence of demand for alternative AI accelerators, though limited data-center capacity constrains deployments and the backlog is not recognized revenue.

activeEvents.companyMarket: Foxconn / Hon Hai / NVDA / AAPL / AI servers
activeEvents.headline: Foxconn Q3 net profit rises 34% above consensus; projects high-double-digit AI rack shipment growth in 2027
activeEvents.direction: Positive demand signal, subject to financing and delivery risk
activeEvents.whyItMatters: Nvidia's major AI server assembler reported T$77.5B Q3 net profit versus T$69.6B consensus and forecast high-double-digit 2027 AI rack shipment growth. This is direct downstream supply-chain evidence of continued AI server buildout despite AI capex concerns; it does not quantify incremental GPU orders.

activeEvents.companyMarket: NVDA / US Congress / China AI chip export controls
activeEvents.headline: US senators Warren and Coons demand preservation of Nvidia China export records and briefing on alleged intelligence risks
activeEvents.whyItMatters: A formal congressional document-preservation request and briefing demand escalates the existing Nvidia leadership and export-control controversy into direct oversight of executive-branch export licensing and counterintelligence decisions. The request is not a finding of wrongdoing or an enacted restriction.

activeEvents.companyMarket: Siemens Energy / AI data-center power / NVDA / Nasdaq
activeEvents.headline: Siemens Energy reports €15B data-center power orders and raises FY2027 margin outlook to 14–16%, confirming AI electricity infrastructure demand
activeEvents.whyItMatters: Siemens Energy disclosed roughly €15 billion in data-center-related turbine and grid orders, 9.1% of its record €164 billion backlog, and expects its profit margin to increase to 14–16% in FY2027 from 12.4% in FY2026. This is independently reported order-book evidence of AI data-center electricity infrastructure demand and the power-supply bottleneck relevant to AI compute deployment. It is not evidence that GPU orders increased by the same amount.

activeEvents.companyMarket: NVDA / Nvidia / AI semiconductors / Asian GPU supply chain
activeEvents.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; CFO Colette Kress appointed interim CEO and Harvey Jones named board chair
activeEvents.scope: NVDA / SOX / Nasdaq / AI infrastructure / export policy
activeEvents.whyItMatters: Reuters confirmed Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned November 12 after a board investigation and leadership controversy; CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO, Huang will leave the board and former Synopsys CEO Harvey Jones was named chair. This changes previously speculative succession risk into an actual leadership transition, creating execution, AI ecosystem and US-China export-policy uncertainty. Allegations involving foreign intelligence remain unproven.
